WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date AS d0, period_end_date AS d1
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 6
), lines AS (
  SELECT p.category, f.net_amount AS net, f.standard_cost AS cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.category, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.d0 AND per.d1
  WHERE p.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') AND s.store_id <> 999
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 6 AS fiscal_period, category,
       round(sum(net), 2) AS net_sales_eur,
